items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The interviewer states 'I played with... Lewis Armstrong' and 'That was the last time I played with Lewis Armstrong'. The interviewee only confirms the era ('That's in the 20s') but does not claim to have played with or met him.

ctx.x: Yeah, once you learned the fingering, you could play it. Yeah, yeah.
I played with Allen. I played with Allen, and I played, uh, in Allen with, uh, me and, uh, Lewis, Lewis Armstrong, Allen, and Three Cornets. Yeah, well, that's in the 20s.
